purpose: Audit GW008 Results missing competition_key and inspect source fields
sql: SELECT sm_action, sm_country, sm_division, competition_group, competition_stage, competition_round, COUNT(*) AS rows_count, SUM(CASE WHEN competition_key IS NULL OR TRIM(competition_key)='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_key, MIN(competition_key) AS sample_key FROM `GW008_IMC Results` WHERE game_world_id='GW008' GROUP BY sm_action, sm_country, sm_division, competition_group, competition_stage, competition_round ORDER BY missing_key DESC, rows_count DESC
